newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean prices firm on limited supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean prices firm on limited supply.

text.p: Indian soybean prices firmed on limited supply on Monday, traders said.
Prices rose by 200-250 rupees per tonne on good purchasing from processing plants on strong undertone.
Soyoil prices also firmed on good demand against less supply. Soyoil solvent and refined prices were up by 600 rupees per tonne against last week's closing.

Soymeal and rapeseed extraction prices were steady in little trading activity. Soymeal yellow was $270 per tonne in export for ready shipment. Rapeseed extraction was $135 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was 4,600 rupees FOR Bedibunder and was 4,550 rupees FOR Bhavnagar.
